author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video and check out some of the best Fortnite islands created during the intensive three-week UEFN Student Bootcamp, completed by over 300 students.

This intrepid bunch had five days to learn the toolset, before spending the following two weeks working on their own project, exploring ideas, learning new skills, and solving challenges—all under the mentorship of industry experts. 

Interested in creating your own Fortnite islands? You don’t need to wait for a bootcamp to get started learning UEFN—there are tons of free tutorials online, and you can download the toolset for free! Jump in today and begin your journey: fortnite.com/developer


#UEFNStudentBootcamp, #UnrealEditorForFortnite, #Fortnite, #GameDevelopment
